title: Dex Share Follower Complication Null
symptom: When using Dex Share Follower as the data source in xDrip, the watchface displays BG readings but complications on the Skymaster watchface show null.
cause: It is not possible to use complications when xDrip is a follower (Dex Share Follower).
evidence_quote: apparently it is not possible when xdrip is a follower, much to my frustration
